title: Booking-Time-Left Scale for Crestline Companion Reinstatement Fees
content:
The reinstatement fee on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is scaled by the booking time left on the product, counted in calendar days from the entry date of the most recent trip reinstatement on the certificate or pass to its book-by date, the reinstatement date excluded and the book-by date included.

| Calendar days from the reinstatement date to the book-by date | Scale applied to the fee |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | multiplied by 0.5 |
| more than 30 and up to 90 | multiplied by 0.75 |
| more than 90 | left unscaled |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, book-by date 31 August)

| Reinstatement date | Days counted | Scale |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 30 | 0.5 |
| 31 July | 31 | 0.75 |
| 2 June | 90 | 0.75 |
| 1 June | 91 | unscaled |

The book-by date read is the one shown on the certificate or pass.
